description: `prose schedule` (no `cli`) exits 2 with `cli job create --help`: a schedule is a job; nothing is forwarded or billed.

stderr.text:
OpenProse: INVOCATION_INVALID: Unknown command.
Detail: `schedule` is not a command; did you mean `prose cli job create --help`? A schedule is a job of type schedule created from a JSON spec; it runs every interval_seconds seconds (86400 = daily), not on a cron expression. Nothing was forwarded or sent. To pass these words to the OpenProse language instead, put `--` before them
Action: A schedule job runs every interval_seconds seconds, not on a cron expression. Use `cli job create`, then add --spec-file FILE; `prose cli job create --help` shows the options of `cli job create`.
